Architectural benchmark AB-01: Courtyard Learning Centre. This is an illustrative, unverified design exercise, not a measured reconstruction or construction issue. Work in Model view using actual architectural tool calls. Never draw geometry by writing code or provide a raster substitute.

Stage 1: Build the complete structural wireframe. Use metres in this brief and millimetres in the tools. Plan north is positive Y, east positive X, with the southwest outside corner at (0,0). The building's outer dimensions are 24 m east-west by 18 m north-south. It is U-shaped: west and east wings are each 6 m wide, linked by a north wing 6 m deep, leaving a 12 m wide by 12 m deep courtyard open to the south. Two levels at 0 and 3.6 m, each 3.6 m high. Exactly the eight exterior boundary walls on each level; no internal partitions. Ground floor slab 250 mm thick under the U footprint, with its top at 0. Upper floor slab 250 mm thick with its top at 3.6 m. Flat roof at 7.2 m, with zero eaves and the same U footprint; do not cover the courtyard.

Reserve a 1.2 m by 7.2 m straight stairwell wholly inside the west wing, open through the upper floor, with adequate space at both ends. Build the upper floor around this opening using supported geometry. Stairs and openings come in stage 2. Read back your geometry and verify dimensions, levels and courtyard/stairwell openings. Save it, mount it in Model mode as wireframe and capture the real view. Explain unsupported items and actual failures honestly.
